listenings.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. This is your captain speaking. We are landing in Orlando in fifteen minutes. The local time is four fifteen in the afternoon, and the weather is sunny and warm. After the plane, please follow the signs to immigration. American citizens go to the line on the left. Visitors go to the line on the right. Please have your passport ready. Your bags are going to be at baggage claim, on level one. Thank you for flying with us, and welcome to Orlando.

Hi, Mister Rodrigues. This is Kelly, your driver from the Lakeside Hotel. I am at the airport now. I am waiting at baggage claim, at door number five. I am wearing a blue jacket, and I am holding a sign with your name. Your flight was a little late, but no problem. The hotel is thirty minutes from the airport. If you cannot find me, you can call me at this number. See you soon!

extra_audio.text: The plane is landing in Orlando. Carlos is waiting in the immigration line. The officer asks for his passport and visa. He says: We are going to stay ten days. He gets the bags at baggage claim. Kelly, the driver, is waiting at door five.
